module.title: Newtonian MHD: constrained transport, MHD Riemann solvers, shearing box, AMR waves
module.expensive_path: HLLD/Roe MHD Riemann solves plus the constrained-transport EMF averaging and face-field update each stage; the shearing-box remap and the AMR prolongation/restriction of face fields add communication-heavy work.
module.rationale: Divergence-free magnetic field evolution is distinct physics and distinct code (field/, CT, EMF corners) from pure hydro, with its own solvers and its own regression set.
excluded: mpi/omp/hybrid linwave: parallel-runtime variants of mhd_linwave, not separate physics
hazards: mhd_shwave needs FFTW for the shearing-box remap
amr_linwave is sensitive to AMR prolongation order; expect a wider floor
